Text: WHEN the POS sends a completed purchase event, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for the member.
WHEN 24 hours have passed since a purchase without a return, the loyalty service shall post the pending points of that purchase.
Rationale: Return window from the programme terms.

Text: WHEN a member asks the app for a voucher, the loyalty service shall issue the voucher only if the member has at least 500 posted points.
WHEN the POS sends a voucher validation request, the loyalty service shall return the validation result within TBD ms for 95% of requests.
The loyalty service shall reject API requests from the POS and the customer mobile app that do not carry valid client credentials.
The loyalty service shall encrypt member personal data in transit on its interfaces with the POS and the customer mobile app.
Rationale: Member data is encrypted on the wire (SH-05).

Text: The loyalty service shall run on the shared Kubernetes platform.
Rationale: Platform team standard for every new service.
